source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of capacitors and isolated spheres (PDF 67-68).

blocks.text: Capacitor aisa aala hai jo bijli ki tawanai electric field ki shakal mein jama kar sakta hai. Yahan do aise aalaat ki baat hai: akele spherical conductors aur parallel-plate capacitors (16.5).
Doosre conductors ya asraat se door spherical conductor akela (isolated) spherical conductor kehlata hai. Charge jama karne ki is ki salahiyat capacitance, C, kehlati hai.

blocks.title: Akele gole ki capacitance
blocks.text: Akele spherical conductor ki capacitance gole par jama charge fi ikai satah ka electric potential hai: C = Q/V (16.25). SI ikai farad (F) hai: 1 F us gole ki capacitance hai jo 1 volt potential par 1 coulomb jama kare (1 F = 1 C / 1 V).

Radius R aur charge Q wale gole ki satah par potential V = (1/4 pi eo) Q / R hai. C = Q/V mein rakhne se C = 4 pi eo R (16.26). Dielectric constant er wale medium mein C = 4 pi eo er R (16.27). Yun spherical conductor ki capacitance charge ya potential par munhasir nahi; yeh sirf radius aur medium par munhasir hai. Bara gola usi satah potential par zyada charge jama karta hai, aur dielectric medium capacitance barhata hai.

Hawa mein 10 cm radius ke akele dhaat ke gole ki capacitance maloom karein. Hal: C = 4 pi eo R = 4 x 3.14 x (8.85 x 10^-12 F m^-1)(0.10 m) = 1.1 x 10^-11 F = 11 pF. Poori zameen (R = 6.4 x 10^6 m) ki capacitance bhi sirf taqreeban 7 x 10^-4 F hai, jo dikhata hai ke aik farad bohat bari ikai hai.

blocks.prompt: Do akele golon ke radius 5 cm aur 10 cm hain. Kis ki capacitance zyada hai, aur kitne guna?
blocks.explanation: 10 cm wale gole ki, dugni, kyunke C = 4 pi eo R, R ke mutanasib hai.

items: Capacitor tawanai electric field mein jama karta.
Akela gola: C = Q/V = 4 pi eo R (medium mein 4 pi eo er R).
